findings.issue: Report does not include a caveat that the data is synthetic. When presented to the sponsor without this disclosure, it may be misunderstood as real production data, creating credibility and transparency issues.

Denial and fraud rates are shown as proportions (0.100117, 0.050370) without displaying the numerator and denominator (e.g., 1286/12845), reducing transparency about sample sizes and evidence for rates.
findings.suggested_change: Set write_report parameter show_denominators to true.

summary: Execution successfully covers all task requirements with 7 components executed and all required artifacts produced. Two presentation choices warrant revision for transparency and credibility when handing to the sponsor.
